hero.tagline: Build and ship Rayfin apps by chatting with an AI agent.

progress.ready: Everything's ready. You can start building.
progress.start: Let's get Fabricator set up. This usually takes a minute.

busy.title: Another installation is already running on this computer.
busy.fix: Wait for it to finish — a Windows update often causes this — then try again.

permission.title: Fabricator does not have permission to install this.
permission.fix: Close Fabricator, right-click it and choose "Run as administrator", then try again. If your computer is managed by your workplace, your IT team may need to install it for you.

offline.title: Fabricator couldn't reach the internet to download this.
offline.fix: Check your connection and try again. If you are on a work network or a VPN, it may be blocking the download.

diskFull.title: There is not enough free space to install this.
diskFull.fix: Free up some disk space and try again.

noWinget.title: This computer doesn't have the Windows package installer (winget).
noWinget.fix: Install it from the Microsoft Store by searching for "App Installer", or use the download link to install the tool yourself.

noHomebrew.title: This Mac doesn't have Homebrew, which Fabricator uses to install tools.
noHomebrew.fix: Install Homebrew from brew.sh, or use the download link to install the tool yourself.

cancelled.title: The install was cancelled.
cancelled.fix: Try again when you are ready.

sso.title: Your organization needs you to sign in through it first.
sso.fix: Finish the sign-in your browser opened, including any extra organization step, then try again.

noCopilot.title: This account doesn't have GitHub Copilot available.
noCopilot.fix: Sign in with an account that has Copilot, or set it up at github.com/features/copilot.

notOnPath.title: The tool installed, but this computer cannot see it yet.
notOnPath.fix: Restart Fabricator so it picks up the new tool.

problems.unknownFix: If this keeps happening, ask Help — it can read what went wrong and explain it.

relaunch.message: Almost there. Restart to finish setting up the tools that were just installed.

copilot.title: Connect GitHub Copilot
copilot.note: The AI that builds your app — and that answers your questions while you set the rest up
copilot.subtitle: Sign in to start building, and to unlock Help
copilot.helpReady: Help is available now. If anything below goes wrong, select Help and it will read what happened.

tools.title: Install the tools
tools.note: Free tools Fabricator uses behind the scenes. It can install them for you.
tools.resolveChecks: Resolve the CLI check errors first
tools.offline: You're offline, so Fabricator can't download these yet. Reconnect and select Re-check.

purpose.node: Runs your app on this computer while you build it
purpose.npm: Fetches the building blocks your app is made from
purpose.git: Keeps a history of your app so you can always go back
purpose.az: Lets Fabricator sign you in to Azure
purpose.gh: Lets Fabricator work with your code on GitHub
purpose.fallback: Used by Fabricator behind the scenes

tools.versionNeedsNewer: Version {{version}} — Fabricator needs a newer version
tools.unknownVersionNeedsMin: Version unknown — Fabricator needs {{min}} or newer
tools.unknownVersionNeedsNewer: Version unknown — Fabricator needs a newer version

azure.title: Sign in to Azure
azure.note: Optional. Lets you share apps, add Fabric data and migrate Power BI reports. You can also sign in later.
azure.subtitle: Access your Azure resources

finish.restart: Restart Fabricator to finish setting up the tools that were just installed.
finish.ready: Your tools are installed and your accounts are connected.
finish.readyWithoutAzure: Your tools are installed and GitHub Copilot is connected. Sign in to Azure whenever you need it.
finish.stepsLeft_one: Finish the step above to continue.
finish.stepsLeft_other: Finish the {{count}} steps above to continue.

log.manualInstall: Finish the install in the page that opened, then click “Restart”.

actionBar.helpTitle: Ask Help about anything that is not working
actionBar.helpOfflineTitle: Get help with setup — including the documentation

signingIn.label: Signing in
signingIn.title: Signing you in…
signingIn.browser: Finish signing in to {{provider}} in your browser, or follow the device-code instructions below.

run.failed: {{action}} did not complete. Please try again.
run.installFailed: {{action}} did not complete. Check the process output.
